from pathlib import Path
import json, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SIDE=227.1845065
N=256

def endpoints(st):
    x,y,angle,length,radius,color=st
    direction=np.array([np.cos(angle),np.sin(angle)])
    a=np.array([x,y])-length*.5*direction
    b=np.array([x,y])+length*.5*direction
    lower,upper=0.,1.
    for j in range(2):
        if abs(b[j]-a[j])>1e-6:
            t0=(1-a[j])/(b[j]-a[j])
            t1=(N-1-a[j])/(b[j]-a[j])
            lower=max(lower,min(t0,t1))
            upper=min(upper,max(t0,t1))
    return (a+(b-a)*lower)*SIDE/N,(a+(b-a)*upper)*SIDE/N

def main():
    strokes=np.loadtxt(ROOT/'strokes.txt')
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json')
    s.reset()
    p=s.primitives()
    move=p['move_tip']
    wells=s.wells()
    active=None
    s.record_start()
    started=time.time()
    def move_xy(xy,z,speed=.15,settle=3):
        result=move([float(xy[0]),float(xy[1]),z],speed=speed,settle=settle)
        if result['ik_failures']:
            raise RuntimeError(f'IK failure: {result}')
    for i,st in enumerate(strokes):
        color=int(st[5])
        if active!=color:
            xy=wells[color]['center_xy']
            move_xy(xy,.055,speed=.18,settle=3)
            move_xy(xy,.023,speed=.045,settle=4)
            move_xy(xy,.055,speed=.09,settle=3)
            assert s.brush_state()['color']==wells[color]['name']
            active=color
        start,end=endpoints(st)
        width=2*st[4]*SIDE/N
        depth=np.interp(width,[4.8,5.325,7.1,9.096,10.427,10.871],[1.8,2,3,5,7,9])/1000
        a=s.geo.mm_to_world(*start)
        b=s.geo.mm_to_world(*end)
        move_xy(a,.05,speed=.18,settle=4)
        move_xy(a,.020-depth,speed=.025,settle=5)
        move_xy(b,.020-depth,speed=.035,settle=4)
        move_xy(b,.05,speed=.06,settle=4)
        if (i+1)%20==0 or i==len(strokes)-1:
            Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT/'canvas.png')
            print(json.dumps({'stroke':i+1,'steps':s.n_steps,'elapsed_s':round(time.time()-started,1)}),flush=True)
    p['hold'](10)
    actions=s.record_stop()
    s.save_trajectory(actions,ROOT/'trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT/'canvas.png')
    np.save(ROOT/'ink.npy',s.ink())
    records=s.strokes()
    lengths=[r['length_mm'] for r in records if r['sheet']=='main' and r['inked']]
    print('MAIN CONTACTS',len(lengths),'PATH MM',sum(lengths),'STATE',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
    stats=s.status()
    (ROOT/'score.json').write_text(json.dumps(stats,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(stats,indent=2),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
